claims: The Artemis II Space Launch System (SLS) generates 8.8 million pounds of liftoff thrust.
Saturn V generates 7.6 million pounds of liftoff thrust.
Saturn V is 363 feet (111 meters) tall.
SLS Block 1 used in Artemis II is 322 feet (98 meters) tall.
SLS produces ~15% more thrust than Saturn V.
SLS is the most powerful rocket ever launched, according to [NASA].
Saturn V payload capacity to Trans-Lunar Injection is approx. 50 tons.
SLS Block 1 payload capacity to Trans-Lunar Injection is approx. 27 tons.
Saturn V used five F-1 engines (kerosene/oxygen).
SLS uses two solid rocket boosters.
Artemis II carries four astronauts in the Orion capsule.
Saturn V carried three astronauts in the Apollo CSM.
